ModMetaData.name: Rimworld Statistics - Smart Apparel Upgrade Addon
ModMetaData.author: pengin0503
ModMetaData.description:
Optional statistics addon for Smart Apparel Upgrade 1.0.1. Records successfully issued automatic Wear-job orders, not completed outfit changes, using the experimental Rimworld Statistics SDK. No polling and no copies of SDK/game DLLs. Inactive without the target mod or statistics host.
Smart Apparel Upgrade 1.0.1向け任意統計アドオン。自動Wearジョブの発行成功回数を記録します（着替え完了回数ではありません）。ホストが無い・対象MODが無い場合は何も記録しません。実験的統計の有効化と再起動が必要です。
